reuse_policy: Source articles are factual inspiration only. No case narrative, patient record, numeric result, image or table was copied. Licenses for articles other than the cited CC BY metoclopramide report have not been independently verified; do not republish or redistribute source text or images.

records.adaptation: Original synthetic dialogue contrasts a mild lifting-related ache with later abrupt chest-and-back pain and an apparently normal first chest radiograph; no published patient attributes, results, treatment or outcome copied.
records.source_to_label_limit: Case report illustrates that a normal chest radiograph can occur with dissection; the AHA describes sudden severe chest/back pain as an aortic warning sign. Neither proves dissection in this synthetic patient or validates the exact scoring boundary.
